<P style="margin:0px; font-size:12pt" align=justify>ITEM 1. PROXY VOTING RECORD: (see attached table)</P>
<P style="margin:0px"><BR></P>
<P style="margin:0px; text-indent:48px; font-size:12pt" align=justify>Item 1, Exhibit A contains the following information indicating for each matter relating to a portfolio security owned by the Registrant considered at any shareholder meeting held during the twelve month period ended June 30, 2012 with respect to which the Registrant was entitled to vote*:</P>
<P style="margin:0px"><BR></P>
<P style="margin:0px; font-size:12pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;(a) &nbsp;The name of the issuer of the portfolio security;</P>
<P style="margin:0px"><BR></P>
<P style="margin:0px; font-size:12pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;(b) &nbsp;The exchange ticker symbol of the portfolio security;</P>
<P style="margin:0px"><BR></P>
<P style="margin:0px; font-size:12pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;(c) &nbsp;&nbsp;The Council on Uniform Securities Identification Procedures (&quot;CUSIP&quot;) number for the portfolio security;</P>
<P style="margin:0px"><BR></P>
<P style="margin:0px; font-size:12pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;(d) &nbsp;The shareholder meeting date;</P>
<P style="margin:0px"><BR></P>
<P style="margin:0px; font-size:12pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;(e) &nbsp;A brief identification of the matter voted on;</P>
<P style="margin:0px"><BR></P>
<P style="margin:0px; font-size:12pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;(f) &nbsp;Whether the matter was proposed by the issuer or by a security holder;</P>
<P style="margin:0px"><BR></P>
<P style="margin:0px; font-size:12pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;(g) &nbsp;Whether the Registrant cast its vote on the matter;</P>
<P style="margin:0px"><BR></P>
<P style="margin:0px; font-size:12pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;(h) &nbsp;How the Registrant cast its vote (e.g., for or against proposal, or abstain; for or withhold regarding election of directors); and</P>
<P style="margin:0px"><BR></P>
<P style="margin:0px; font-size:12pt">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;(i) &nbsp;Whether the Registrant cast its vote for or against management.</P>
<P style="margin:0px"><BR></P>
<P style="margin:0px; font-size:12pt">*Certain proxy voting records of certain series of the Registrant are unavailable to the Registrant and, therefore, the information contained in this report with respect to those series may be incomplete.</P>
